content: I regret buying this foam mattress that arrived vacuum-sealed in a box three months ago. Despite following all the instructions and waiting 72 hours for it to fully expand, it never reached the advertised 10-inch height and remains noticeably lopsided. The "cooling gel" layer is a joke - I wake up drenched in sweat every night because this mattress traps heat like a furnace. After just 12 weeks of use, there's already a permanent body-shaped indent where I sleep, making it impossible to get comfortable. The chemical smell was overwhelming for the first two weeks, giving me headaches despite airing it out by an open window. The edges provide zero support, so I feel like I'm rolling off the bed whenever I sit or sleep near the sides. My back pain has actually gotten worse since switching to this mattress, and I wake up stiff and sore every morning. Save your money and invest in a quality traditional mattress instead of this overpriced foam disappointment.
